messages.subject: Help; rstan not running on new computer

[12] tools_3.2.2      stringr_1.0.0    munsell_0.4.2    parallel_3.2.2   inline_0.3.14    colorspace_1.2-6 gridExtra_2.0.0 
> 


and here is the error I get when I try to run the 8schools example:

Warning message:
running command 'make -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/etc/x64/Makeconf" -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/share/make/winshlib.mk" -f "C:/Users/Ed/Documents/.R/Makevars" SHLIB_LDFLAGS='$(SHLIB_CXXLDFLAGS)' SHLIB_LD='$(SHLIB_CXXLD)' SHLIB="file10a43ea732d2.dll" WIN=64 TCLBIN=64 OBJECTS="file10a43ea732d2.o"' had status 127 

ERROR(s) during compilation: source code errors or compiler configuration errors!

Then I  see around 500 lines of code, and then this at the end:

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! Warning message:
running command 'make -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/etc/x64/Makeconf" -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/share/make/winshlib.mk" -f "C:/Users/Ed/Documents/.R/Makevars" SHLIB_LDFLAGS='$(SHLIB_CXXLDFLAGS)' SHLIB_LD='$(SHLIB_CXXLD)' SHLIB="file10a43ea732d2.dll" WIN=64 TCLBIN=64 OBJECTS="file10a43ea732d2.o"' had status 127 
In addition: Warning message:
running command 'C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/bin/x64/R CMD SHLIB file10a43ea732d2.cpp 2> file10a43ea732d2.cpp.err.txt' had status 1 

I get the same result if I use Rtools 3.2.3.  

Any help would be much appreciated!

- Ed Green

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Help; rstan not running on new computer
parts:
On Thursday, September 24, 2015 at 4:30:44 PM UTC-4, Ed Green wrote:
Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! Warning message:
running command 'make -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/etc/x64/Makeconf" -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/share/make/winshlib.mk" -f "C:/Users/Ed/Documents/.R/Makevars" SHLIB_LDFLAGS='$(SHLIB_CXXLDFLAGS)' SHLIB_LD='$(SHLIB_CXXLD)' SHLIB="file10a43ea732d2.dll" WIN=64 TCLBIN=64 OBJECTS="file10a43ea732d2.o"' had status 127 
In addition: Warning message:
running command 'C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/bin/x64/R CMD SHLIB file10a43ea732d2.cpp 2> file10a43ea732d2.cpp.err.txt' had status 1 

I get the same result if I use Rtools 3.2.3.

status 127 means it couldn't find g++, which usually means that the PATH didn't get updated during the installation of Rtools. There is a box you have to check. See this image and the following text

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/Install-Rtools-for-Windows#check-if-rtools-can-be-used-in-r

You can also try devtools::find_rtools() if you have the devtools package installed.

Ben
